leadText: The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation of .
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the Japanese language home video releases of Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation of .

==Volume releases==
Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation was divided into four sets that were released by and Shogakukan. It contains almost all the 192 episodes between them. All the DVDs were released for rental only.

===Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation===
Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation was released by and Shogakukan in 2006. It consists of 15 volumes with 45 episodes across them combined.

Attack of the Konohana Family! was released separately. It is included on a DVD along with the Pikachu short Secret Base of the Dancing Pokémon.

 

===Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation 2004===
Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation 2004 was released by and Shogakukan starting in 2004. It consists of 15 volumes with 44 episodes across them combined.

 

===Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation 2005===
Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation 2005 was released by and Shogakukan starting in 2005. It consists of 15 volumes with 44 episodes across them combined.

 

===Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation Battle Frontier===
Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation Battle Frontier was released by and Shogakukan starting in 2006. It consists of 19 volumes with 55 episodes across them combined and it concludes the Pocket Monsters Advanced Generation series.

Esper VS Ghost! Midnight Duel!? was released separately. It is included on a DVD along with the Pikachu short Pikachu's Ghost Carnival.

Pokémon Ranger! Deoxys Crisis!! (Part One) and Pokémon Ranger! Deoxys Crisis!! (Part Two) were released as part of a special set.
